assumptions: Inference is a keyword heuristic over title then body. Rule order is bug > documentation > chore, and anything unmatched defaults to enhancement, which matches roadmap-fleet's documented safe default. Every item carries a reason so the dry run can be reviewed.
Roadmap rows carry no type field, so the roadmap row is not an inference source. Title and body only.
An issue is already typed if it has any label from the existing vocabulary: bug, enhancement, documentation, chore, question, spike or decision. No new labels are minted.
Only open harness-managed issues are in scope. --apply only adds labels and never removes one.
Exit 3 means zero denominator (no harness-managed issue examined), following the repo gate convention (#508).

The live dry run on 2026-09-15 examined 26 open harness-managed issues and found 0 untyped. The backlog has since been hand-typed (all carry enhancement), so the script is a standing tool for new roadmap-synced issues until upstream #2146 lands. --apply was not run.
